extracted.name: Healthy Peanut Butter Mousse
extracted.description: Whip up this quick and easy mousse with peanut butter, Greek yogurt, and chocolate chips the next time you need a healthy after-school snack.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon chocolate chips, or to taste
instruction_lines: Microwave peanut butter in a microwave-safe bowl until liquid and smooth, about 20 seconds.
Stir Greek yogurt into the peanut butter with a spoon until smooth, scraping off any peanut butter stuck to the spoon. Stir in stevia and vanilla extract. Fold in chocolate chips.
